title: "Mixed Models & BLUP"

## TL;DR

::: {.callout-tip}
The mixed model $\mathbf{y} = \mathbf{Xb} + \mathbf{Zu} + \mathbf{e}$ with
$\mathbf{u} \sim N(\mathbf{0}, \mathbf{A}\sigma_u^2)$ underpins both packages.
BLUP is the conditional expectation of $\mathbf{u}$ given $\mathbf{y}$.
:::

## The model

$$
\mathbf{y} = \mathbf{Xb} + \mathbf{Zu} + \mathbf{e}
$$ {#eq-mixed-model}

where:

- $\mathbf{y}$ is the vector of phenotypes
- $\mathbf{X}, \mathbf{Z}$ are design matrices for fixed and random effects
- $\mathbf{b}$ is the fixed-effects vector
- $\mathbf{u}$ is the random additive genetic effects vector
- $\mathbf{e}$ is the residual
